title: A brand dinner *at the Pyramids.*
subtitle: Draft structure for YKONE's first Egypt brief, built on the dinner idea from our follow-up. It becomes a proposal once YKONE shares a live brief.
draft: Draft · fees not approved · not for client

blocks.text: YKONE leads the client, the creative and the talent. NOYA runs the Egypt side: a private brand dinner beside the Pyramids or at the Grand Egyptian Museum, with talent and guests hosted from arrival to departure.

items: Three days: arrivals, dinner, content morning

rows: Venue options at Giza or the Grand Egyptian Museum; permits through our local partners
VIP airport reception, chauffeurs, hotel stays, a NOYA host throughout
Catering, staging partners and service, to YKONE's creative direction
A private guided visit with access windows planned for content
Security plan for talent and guests
One NOYA lead, under YKONE's name
Arrivals, transfers and check-in; welcome dinner for talent
Private guided visit for content; departures

blocks.text: A fixed NOYA hosting and production-management fee, plus pass-through costs at the rates NOYA secures.
Every arrangement is presented for approval before it is confirmed.

items.text: YKONE leads creative, talent and the client relationship.
Guest numbers, dates and venue come from YKONE's brief.
Pass-through costs are quoted at the rates NOYA secures and approved before booking.

blocks.text: Venues, access and dates are subject to permits, approvals and availability. NOYA confirms each before anything is presented to a client.
